ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Copy From or To System Directory
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects a suspicious copy operation that tries to copy a program from system (System32, SysWOW64, WinSxS) directories to another on disk.
Often used to move LOLBINs such as 'certutil' or 'desktopimgdownldr' to a different location with a different name in order to bypass detections based on locations.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*copy\\ .*")) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*copy\\-item.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ copy\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cpi\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ cp\\ .*"))) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\robocopy\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\xcopy\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "robocopy\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "XCOPY\.EXE"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\System32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SysWOW64.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\WinSxS.*"))
